title: kbs now shows placeholders/mocks instead of fail-closed JIT
description:
Observed: `kbs now` emits placeholder or mock right-now strings instead of failing closed when real JIT generation is unavailable or fails.

Expected:
- Production `kbs now` generates real summaries just-in-time via the LLM pipeline
- On failure (missing key, LLM error, validation), fail closed with a clear error — never substitute mock/placeholder text
- SD acceptance on `/workspace/projects-meta`
